resources.string: Shown while the touch lock is armed or active.
Locking in %1$d s. Switch back to the call now.
Stops them outright instead of returning to the call afterwards. Works with the volume gestures; while active, a three-finger triple tap is the touch fallback to unlock.
Child Lock could not start. Nothing is locked.
Set a PIN first, or choose a different unlock gesture
Child Lock is active. Touch is disabled.

Optional hardening for Child Lock. Only active while the touch lock is on: it swallows the back and volume buttons, closes the notification shade if it is pulled down, and returns to the video call if the child leaves it. It also recognises the volume-button pattern that switches the lock on and off. It never reads or stores what is on screen.
Volume-button lock toggle and hardening for Child Lock
Switch back to the call now.
Touch is frozen. Safe to hand over.
Your gesture needs the accessibility guard, which is off.
Returns you to the previous app, then freezes touch. The Child Lock tile in Quick Settings does the same.
Required. How touches are blocked without covering the screen.
A silent entry in the shade while locked. No status-bar icon.
Needed for the volume gestures and to block swipes, buttons and the notification shade while locked.
Seeing “App was denied access”? Try the switch once, then open App info, tap ⋮ top right, choose “Allow restricted settings”, and try again.
A quick press of the volume buttons. The same pattern locks and unlocks, no screen touching. Needs the accessibility guard.
One finger in each of two opposite corners, held together. Any extra finger restarts the timer.
Hold the badge until a keypad appears, then type your PIN. Three wrong tries hide it for 30 s.
Both volume buttons held at once for the hold duration. Needs the accessibility guard.
Up, down, up, down. Harder for small hands to hit by accident.
The two-finger corner hold always works as a backup way to unlock.
4 to 8 digits, typed on a small keypad beside the badge.
Stops the screen timing out during the call.
While locked, with the accessibility guard on
Volume still works for the volume gestures.
Closes it the moment it is pulled down.
If the child reaches the home screen, the call app is brought straight back.
While on the call, press volume %1$s. A message confirms “Child Lock on”.
Tap the Child Lock tile in Quick Settings, or tap the button below and switch back to the call.
Press volume %1$s again. A message confirms “Child Lock off”.
Hold one finger in each chosen corner for the hold duration. A ring fills around the badge; a buzz confirms the unlock.
Hold the badge for the hold duration until the keypad appears, then enter your PIN.
Hold volume up and volume down together for the hold duration. The corner hold also works.

The lock is never saved. If anything goes wrong, restart the phone and it starts unlocked. The power button always works. The Quick Settings tile can lock but never unlock, so finding the shade does not help a child.
